purpose: Layered dependency inventory for the transform-first knowledge pipeline.
rule: Do not install every library at once. Install by phase as the golden path proves each layer.

phase_1_core_now.description: Contracts, state, config, frontmatter, Ollama calls, retry logic, file detection, text encoding, and tests.

libraries.purpose: Pydantic contracts for ExtractionResult, GateDecision, DecisionNote, and StateEntry.
Atomic/locked state writes through the canonical StateManager.
Read and write Obsidian-compatible YAML frontmatter.
YAML support for frontmatter and small config files.
HTTP calls to local Ollama/LLM endpoints.
Retry logic around local LLM and fragile extraction boundaries.
MIME/magic-byte detection so extension is not treated as truth.
Detect and handle messy text encodings.
Golden path and contract tests.

phase_2_documents_later.description: Document extraction after core contracts and golden path tests exist.

libraries.purpose: Modern Word XML documents.
Inspect legacy Microsoft OLE compound files without confusing them with modern XML formats.
Extract text from RTF.
Modern Excel XML spreadsheets.
Legacy Excel spreadsheets.
Modern PowerPoint presentations.
Fast PDF text, metadata, and page inspection.
Layout-aware PDF text/table extraction.
Clean HTML extraction.
Fast parser backend for HTML/XML.
Tabular previews and spreadsheet summaries.

phase_3_ocr_media_later.description: OCR, image, audio, video, and design-file metadata after transform-first golden path is proven.

libraries.purpose: OCR wrapper for scanned PDFs and images.
Convert PDF pages to images for OCR.
Image handling for OCR and metadata.
Local speech-to-text transcription.
Media probing and audio extraction from video.
PSD metadata and layer inspection.

blocked_for_now: Do not install OCR/media stacks until the golden path contracts pass.
Do not add broad document extraction before ExtractionResult and GateDecision are locked.
Do not use dependency installation as proof of architectural progress.
